title: Unknown USB Device
briefing: An employee finds an unknown USB drive in the office parking lot and brings it inside. What is the safest response?
options: Plug it into a workstation to identify the owner
Turn it in to the security team
Leave it at the reception desk
answer: Turn it in to the security team

feedback.Plug it into a workstation to identify t: Incorrect. Unknown USB devices can contain malware and should never be connected to organizational systems.
feedback.Turn it in to the security team: Correct. Security teams can safely analyze the device using controlled procedures.
feedback.Leave it at the reception desk: Risky. Reception staff are unlikely to follow secure handling procedures for suspicious hardware.
